context.validated_for: uncached long-context retrieval and sustained generation

caveats: This evidence is for the explicitly non-thinking request route (thinking disabled at the request level). Thinking-enabled behaviour requires separate evidence.
Retrieval passed twice at ~115.4K prompt tokens; sustained generation passed twice at ~91.8K prompt tokens with client-visible output required.
An earlier 2026-08-14 profile run passed retrieval but only one of two sustained repeats produced the required visible output; the promoted receipt is the retry profile that passed every check.

The retry receipt recorded a 131072-token requested route but the endpoint did not expose active/effective server-context metadata; the evidence directly establishes ~115.4K-token retrieval and ~91.8K-token sustained generation.
131K is the configured profile tier for this route, not a maximum-context claim.
Measured with the seed cards' core/SM clock locked at 2300 MHz; throughput is specific to that operating point.
